name: scaly
description: Scaly language support: the scalyls language server, run/build/test tasks, and debugging through lldb-dap (on Windows the Visual Studio debugger)

scaly.server.path.description: Path to the scalyls language server binary. Default 'scalyls' resolves it on PATH (the scaly.io installer's wrapper); falls back to ~/.scaly/bin/scalyls.

scaly.compiler.path.description: Path to the scalyc binary, used by the 'Run (scalyc --jit)' code lens. Default 'scalyc' resolves it on PATH (the scaly.io installer's wrapper); falls back to ~/.scaly/bin/scalyc.

scaly.home.description: SCALY_HOME passed to the server (prelude/packages search root). If empty, the first workspace folder is used.

scaly.debugAdapter.path.description: Path to the lldb-dap debug adapter (macOS and Linux). Empty auto-detects: PATH, then the LLVM 21 prefix, then Xcode's copy. lldb-dap ships with LLVM and with Xcode — nothing extra to install. On Windows the extension debugs with the Visual Studio debugger of Microsoft's C/C++ extension instead.

scaly.formatters.path.description: Path to tools/lldb/scaly.py (the String/Vector/Array/List data formatters). Empty derives it from scaly.home, then SCALY_HOME, then the first workspace folder.

scaly.tool.path.description: Path to the scaly tool, used by the run/build/test tasks and to build a program for debugging. Default 'scaly' resolves it on PATH; falls back to ~/.scaly/bin/scaly.

source.description: A Scaly file to build with debug information before the launch (`scaly build -g`); the program is written beside it unless `program` says where.

program.description: The executable to debug. With `source` it is what the build writes (default: beside the source). Without, a program compiled with `-g` -- without it there are no line tables, so breakpoints cannot bind.

args.description: Command-line arguments passed to the program.

stopOnEntry.description: Stop at the program's entry point.

initCommands.description: lldb commands run before the target is created. Left unset, the extension injects `command script import <scaly>/tools/lldb/scaly.py` so String renders as text and Vector/Array/List show their elements. Set it to [] to opt out.

program.description: Path to the executable of the running process (for symbols).

configurationSnippets.label: Scaly: Debug the open file
configurationSnippets.description: Build the open .scaly file with -g and debug it

configurationSnippets.label: Scaly: Launch a program
configurationSnippets.description: Debug a Scaly executable compiled with -g

command.description: run: `scaly run`; build: `scaly build -g` beside the file; test: `scaly test`.

file.description: The Scaly file; the active editor's when left out (or `${file}`).

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run bundle && npm run formatters
